HAZ_ZONE_MASS_01.title: The Crushing Lowlands (Zone of Mass)
HAZ_ZONE_MASS_01.narrative_prompt: The air pressure suddenly drops, and the flattened earth before you groans. The gravity here rolls in waves; you are about to be hit by a 10x gravitational compression.

detection.success_effect: You notice the dust settling unnaturally fast before the wave hits.

HAZ_ZONE_ORDO_02.title: The Frozen Grid (Zone of Ordo)
HAZ_ZONE_ORDO_02.narrative_prompt: The landscape squares off into pixelated, imposing geometry. A flash-freezing storm of absolute zero is sweeping through, freezing falling stones in mid-air.

detection.success_effect: You feel the kinetic energy draining from the air.

HAZ_ZONE_MOTUS_03.title: The Kinetic Wastes (Zone of Motus)
HAZ_ZONE_MOTUS_03.narrative_prompt: Distance is a lie here. Supersonic winds scream past, carrying 'Sonic Vines' that whip out with the concussive force of a sonic boom.

detection.success_effect: You gauge the deceptive distance and spot the incoming vector.

failure_consequence.injury: 1 Minor Body Injury (Ruptured Eardrums / 'The Blur' Warp)

HAZ_ZONE_FLUX_04.title: The Gilded Bog (Zone of Flux)
HAZ_ZONE_FLUX_04.narrative_prompt: The states of matter are deeply confused. The solid stone path ahead suddenly loses its cohesion, turning into a pool of acidic, golden sludge.

detection.success_effect: You notice the structural integrity of the stone shifting.

HAZ_ZONE_VITA_05.title: The Chimera Veldt (Zone of Vita)
HAZ_ZONE_VITA_05.narrative_prompt: The air smells of blooming flowers and rotting meat. A cloud of hyper-evolutionary spores erupts from a bleeding rock, threatening to trigger rampant, cancerous mutation.

detection.success_effect: You identify the spore-vent before it bursts.

HAZ_ZONE_NEXUS_06.title: The Tungsten Hells (Zone of Nexus)
HAZ_ZONE_NEXUS_06.narrative_prompt: The heat shimmer creates mirages of burning cities. Above, the dark clouds condense not into water, but into a sudden downpour of liquid magma.

detection.success_effect: You sense the thermal pressure dropping right before the rain.

HAZ_ZONE_RATIO_07.title: The Magnetic Fog (Zone of Ratio)
HAZ_ZONE_RATIO_07.narrative_prompt: The thick white fog smells of ozone. The magnetic field randomly reverses, threatening to hurl all your metal gear—and you—into the upward-striking lightning.

detection.success_effect: You calculate the magnetic inversion seconds before it triggers.

HAZ_ZONE_ANUMIS_08.title: The Shifting Veil (Zone of Anumis)
HAZ_ZONE_ANUMIS_08.narrative_prompt: Distance is sliced into pieces like a bad painting. You step forward, but the space folds, threatening to phase your body into a solid wall.

detection.success_effect: You read the arcane geometry of the rift.

HAZ_ZONE_LUX_09.title: The Prism Spires (Zone of Lux)
HAZ_ZONE_LUX_09.narrative_prompt: Blinding white light obliterates all shadows. You are walking into a forest of razor-sharp, completely invisible glass spires.

detection.success_effect: You catch the microscopic prismatic refractions on the glass.

HAZ_ZONE_OMEN_10.title: The Rotting Gardens (Zone of Omen)
HAZ_ZONE_OMEN_10.narrative_prompt: A wave of accelerated entropy washes over you. Your shadow detaches from your feet, and the flesh on your hands begins to rapidly age and wither.

detection.success_effect: You sense the timeline rotting before it touches you.

HAZ_ZONE_AURA_11.title: The Euphoric Oasis (Zone of Aura)
HAZ_ZONE_AURA_11.narrative_prompt: The air becomes perfumed and tranquil. Wisps of light sing a hypnotic, narcotic song, attempting to lull you into an eternal, mindless slumber.

detection.success_effect: You recognize the false paradise for the trap it is.

failure_consequence.injury: 1 Major Mind Injury (Euphoric Fugue / 'The Glamour' Warp)

HAZ_ZONE_LEX_12.title: The Bedlam Peaks (Zone of Lex)
HAZ_ZONE_LEX_12.narrative_prompt: The landscape reacts to your darkest thoughts. The terrain suddenly folds and snaps like origami, trying to crush you into a simple geometric shape.

detection.success_effect: You spot the geometric fault lines before they fold.
